name: Do I need to empty my kitchen cabinets before an upgrade?

mainEntity.name: Do I need to empty my kitchen cabinets before an upgrade?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, you will need to completely empty your kitchen cabinets before an upgrade project begins. This includes removing all dishes, food, appliances, and any other contents. It's also advisable to clear out drawers and remove any items from countertops that are located directly above or adjacent to the cabinet work areas. This preparation protects your belongings from dust and damage, and allows our team to work efficiently and safely. We recommend finding a temporary storage solution for these items, ideally in another room, to keep them accessible but out of the construction zone.
acceptedAnswer.description: Yes, completely empty all kitchen cabinets, drawers, and clear nearby countertops before an upgrade to protect belongings and ensure safe, efficient work.
